verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only single payout flows: CPN cross-border fiat payouts and developer-controlled wallets described as 'for payouts and treasury'. It shows no batch or bulk disbursement operation with per-item status. The Gateway mention of 'batch processing of EIP-3009 authorizations' is an adjacent settlement primitive, not a documented mass-payout API for ops, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can run mass disbursements — batch or bulk payout APIs that push many stablecoin or fiat payouts in one documented operation with per-item status
